chunks: And through it from Abu Hamza he said:
I asked Abu Abdullah: 'Will the earth remain without an Imam?' He said: 'If the earth were to remain without an Imam, it would sink.'

key_terms.إِمَام: Imam, the divinely appointed leader and authority
key_terms.لَسَاقَتْ: It would sink or fall down

ai.seo_question: What happens to the earth if it is left without an Imam according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Al-Nu'mani's *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Sadiq (as) uses the metaphor of the earth sinking to illustrate the cosmic necessity of the Imam as the *Hujjah* (proof) of God. This concept underscores the Shia belief that the Imam’s presence maintains the ontological stability of the universe, preventing chaos and ensuring the continuity of divine guidance.
